name: Nocturnal-Arete
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are towering mountain ranges, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Approach protocols for the quarantine zone are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Whoever controls rare flora controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
